summary: Data engineer with 7 years building batch and streaming pipelines on AWS and Snowflake. Leads a platform team that moved a retail analytics stack from nightly jobs to near-real-time Kafka and Spark pipelines.

bullets: Rebuilt the order-events pipeline on Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming, cutting dashboard latency from 24 hours to 5 minutes.
Own the Snowflake warehouse (40 TB): dbt models, cost controls and access policies.
Lead a team of four data engineers; run the on-call rotation for the data platform.
Built Airflow DAGs loading 30 source systems into Redshift.
Wrote the Python data-quality framework the analytics team still uses.
